sources.method: width = 25.4*D*a/sqrt(a^2+b^2), height = 25.4*D*b/sqrt(a^2+b^2), rounded half-up to 0.1 mm. D = 5.8 in, a:b = 1080:2092 taken exactly from resolution_px (square pixels assumed); the published diagonal is assumed exact (OEMs round it). Inputs: diagonal_in and resolution_px both from the sources[] entry for 'displays[0]' <https://web.archive.org/web/20240719142602/https://store.google.com/gb/product/pixel_fold_specs?hl=en-GB>. Computed by scripts/device-registry-derive.py; re-run it after editing either input.

width = 25.4*D*a/sqrt(a^2+b^2), height = 25.4*D*b/sqrt(a^2+b^2), rounded half-up to 0.1 mm. notes: The live store.google.com Pixel Fold spec page is GONE: https://store.google.com/us/product/pixel_fold_specs?hl=en-US now 301-redirects to the Pixel 10 Pro Fold product page, and the bare /product/ path geo-redirects to a Google Store home page. Values therefore come from a web.archive.org snapshot of the manufacturer's own UK page (store.google.com/gb/product/pixel_fold_specs?hl=en-GB), SNAPSHOT DATE 2024-07-19; the en-GB locale prints BOTH inches and mm side by side, so the mm figures were taken directly and NO conversion was performed. hinge.free_stop=true and max_angle_deg=180 come from Google's own Hinge section: 'Fluid friction across the full 180 degree range of motion to securely support different postures'. Google also states 'Mirror-polished, multi-alloy steel construction' and 'Custom dual-axis, quad-cam synchronised mechanism' for the hinge. hinge.crease left NULL: Google never describes the crease SHAPE on this page - no teardrop/water-drop/U wording anywhere. resolution_px is exactly as Google prints it: cover '1080 x 2092' (width x height), inner '2208 x 1840'. refresh_hz 120 records Google's 'Smooth Display (up to 120 Hz)'. Camera-bar caveat: the 'Dimensions and weight' heading carries a footnote marker whose body was NOT captured in the snapshot; nothing in the captured text says the 12.1 mm folded depth excludes the camera bar, so treat 12.1 mm as Google's stated figure of unknown reference surface. released left NULL: the announcement blog says only 'will begin shipping next month' - no primary page gives an on-sale date, and the widely cited 2023-06-27 appears only on excluded secondary sites. controls[0].position left null: Google says 'power button fingerprint sensor' but does not state which edge. active_area_mm left null (marketing diagonal only).
